parameters.content:
PURPOSE
Turn public organizational documents into traceable, bounded sources.

OWNER
PAOLA TRACK A

INPUT CONTRACT
run_context + organization + document_candidates[]

OUTPUT CONTRACT
source.schema.json[] + documents[] + controlled_state + errors[]

STATUS
Repository-ready Jina Reader implementation. Inactive by default. No credentials. Public document statements only; no consulting conclusions.

WHAT THE DOCUMENT STATES ≠ WHAT THE CONSULTING SYSTEM CONCLUDES
Extracted sections remain source text. Missing data remains unknown. This workflow never upgrades public document text into an efficiency, performance, or strategy judgment.
